note: One entry for each page. 'published' stays empty until the site is published. 'modified' changes only when the content changes in substance, never on a rebuild or a source recheck. 'next' is the address of the page a "Next" link at the foot leads to, where a page has one outside the reform options section. 'figure_cards' is true where the page has figure cards with "More about this figure", so the page foot says where the check dates are; the build fails if it does not match the page.
